Phosphor Icons Web 2.1.2

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@phosphor-icons/web/v/2.1.2
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Regular, bold and fill styles are bundled with WOFF2 fonts for local/offline use.
Upstream CSS font sources are restricted to the bundled WOFF2 files.

## Platform integration (checked 2026-10-28)

The meeting-summary [page](../../index.html) loads `regular/style.css`, `bold/style.css`, and `fill/style.css` directly from this directory. Keep the CSS and matching font files together when exporting or updating the built-in tool. These assets require no CDN request or frontend build. Preserve the upstream LICENSE when redistributing; the version above identifies the bundled asset, not the latest upstream release.
